steps.name: Choose exhibit and species
steps.do: For **Exhibit**, choose **Africa Savanna**. In **Species**, type **African Lion** and select it from the suggestions.

steps.name: Fill window
steps.do: Leave **Schedule start date** blank. Leave **Last day of schedule** blank. Set **Daily viewing start time** to **11:00 AM** and **Daily viewing end time** to **2:00 PM**. In **Message**, enter a short note (e.g. **Manual test limited viewing**).
steps.expect: Form is ready to save (blank start applies immediately; blank last day keeps the schedule until removed).

steps.name: Submit
steps.expect: Success that **African Lion** in **Africa Savanna** viewing schedule updated.

steps.name: Map limited-viewing cue
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Map**. On **Specific Map**, set the date to today. Find the **African Lion** marker.
steps.expect: A yellow ring/halo appears around the **African Lion** marker.

steps.name: Tooltip/message
steps.expect: The viewing **Message** from step 3 is visible.

steps.name: Remove schedule
steps.do: In Console, select **Remove visibility schedule**. Choose **Africa Savanna** and **African Lion**.

steps.name: Submit remove
steps.expect: Success that **African Lion** in **Africa Savanna** no longer has a visibility schedule.

steps.name: Map cue gone
steps.do: From the bottom nav, return to **Map** on **Specific Map** today. Find **African Lion**.
steps.expect: The yellow ring/halo around the **African Lion** marker is gone.
